div.style: height: 100%; background: var(--fix-color-surface-canvas, #fafafa); display: flex; flex-direction: column;

header.style: display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--fix-dimension-space-sm, 8px); padding: var(--fix-dimension-space-sm, 8px) var(--fix-dimension-space-md, 16px); background: var(--fix-color-surface-primary, #fff); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--fix-color-border-default, #e0e0e0);

h1.style: margin: 0; font-size: var(--fix-typography-size-400, 16px); color: var(--fix-color-text-primary, #242424); flex: 1;

span.t-attf-style: padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: var(--fix-dimension-border-radius-pill, 999px); font-size: var(--fix-typography-size-200, 12px); background: var(--fix-color-surface-secondary, #f5f5f5); color: var(--fix-color-text-primary, #242424);

button.style: border: 1px solid var(--fix-color-border-default, #e0e0e0); border-radius: var(--fix-dimension-border-radius-sm, 4px); padding: var(--fix-dimension-space-xs, 4px) var(--fix-dimension-space-sm, 8px); background: var(--fix-color-surface-primary, #fff); font-size: var(--fix-typography-size-200, 12px); cursor: pointer;

div.style: display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: var(--fix-dimension-space-sm, 8px);

border: 1px solid var(--fix-color-border-default, #e0e0e0); border-radius: var(--fix-dimension-border-radius-md, 8px); padding: var(--fix-dimension-space-sm, 8px) var(--fix-dimension-space-md, 16px); background: var(--fix-color-surface-primary, #fff);
display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--fix-dimension-space-xs, 4px);

span.style: font-size: var(--fix-typography-size-300, 14px); font-weight: 600; color: var(--fix-color-text-primary, #242424); flex: 1;

span.t-attf-style: font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: var(--fix-dimension-border-radius-xs, 2px); background: var(--fix-color-status-warning-bg, #fff9f5); color: var(--fix-color-status-warning, #bc4b09);

div.style: font-size: var(--fix-typography-size-200, 12px); color: var(--fix-color-text-secondary, #616161); margin-top: var(--fix-dimension-space-xs, 4px);
padding: var(--fix-dimension-space-xxl, 48px); text-align: center; color: var(--fix-color-text-ink-faint, #bdbdbd); font-size: var(--fix-typography-size-300, 14px);
